### Observed differences

- Participation is stable: in both windows each of the six activities (A01–A06) appears in all traces, and every activity pair occurs together in 100 in 100 traces, so no activity became optional, mandatory, or an alternative to another [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011].
- Direct successor shares moved only slightly. In the later window, about 10 in 100 of A02's outgoing transitions lead to A01 (about 16 in 100 before) and about 70 in 100 lead to A04 (about 67 before); out of A03, about 45 in 100 go to A01 (about 39 before) and about 8 in 100 to A04 (about 12 before); out of A04, about 52 in 100 go to A01 (about 46 before). The outgoing profiles of A01 and A06 are practically unchanged [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR006].
- The relative order of a few pairs shifted by a few percentage points without changing its character. In the earlier window A05 preceded A04 in about 10 in 100 traces and A02 in about 5 in 100; in the later window, about 17 and about 10 in 100 respectively. A01 preceded A02 in about 14 in 100 traces before and about 20 in 100 after. A02 and A03 remain without a fixed order (about 51/49 before, 45/55 after), and strongly ordered pairs stay strongly ordered, e.g. A03 before A05 in about 97 in 100 traces in both windows [REL001, REL004, REL005, REL008, REL010].
- Event positions moved marginally: in the later window the mean position of A02 is about 0.20 of the trace (about 0.16 before) and of A04 about 0.49 (about 0.45 before), while A05 sits slightly earlier at about 0.94 (about 0.97 before); medians and quartiles are essentially the same [POS002, POS004, POS005].
- Step-gap patterns redistributed a little: A01-to-A04 successions within five steps now span 4 steps in about 40 in 100 cases (about 21 before); A03-to-A02 immediate successions fell from about 77 to 67 in 100 while 4-step gaps rose from about 6 to 15 in 100; A02-to-A01 gaps now concentrate on 2 steps (about 51 in 100) rather than 3 (about 37) [LAG003, LAG006, LAG012].

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence
The evidence is insufficient to infer a change in the process. Only about four of the 49 indicators show differences that are unusual for random re-splits of the two windows [POS002, POS005, REL005, REL010] — roughly the yield an unchanged process would produce by chance across this many tests — and the small shifts they describe (a few percentage points in the order of A05 versus A02/A04 and in the positions of A02 and A04) do not combine into one consistent behavioural difference.
